arithmetic: Node metadata arithmetic only; all performance measurements are native C++
scope: raw elapsed/operation counts and normalized means
all cell summaries and same-round ratio arrays
canonical output byte identity as persisted, across routes, modes lane0 and series
exact calibration growth, streaks and frozen job counts
exact per-round group and route schedules, including warmup offset and reverse series
all phase counts, floor flags, retained short rows and CPU endpoints
limitations: Recorded endpoints are not continuous CPU/frequency monitoring.
Only final identical timed job per region is byte-compared; separate untimed driver replay checks intermediates.
Identical persisted bytes and checksums are not a fresh arithmetic-oracle rerun.
CT route is descriptive with a different security contract; lookup benchmark is not CT proof.
Inverse timings include dependent corpus lookup and cover nonzero inputs only.
Resident excludes preconverted RHS setup; setup observation is not a standalone conversion benchmark.
Bridge unary wrappers retain a second reference argument; measurements describe wrappers as compiled.
Complete recorded schedules and short counts were checked; this audit cannot infer unrecorded external runs.
